catalog.name: Big Blue Chuchu
catalog.coverageNote: Six upright head expressions with genuine narrow neck and wide foot, using the shared Chuchu four-part geometry and normal 1.6× affine scale. All 27 head states and electric effects remain in Boss parts. Falling, defeat curves and the ROM timeline are not reconstructed.

catalog.name: Big Octorok
catalog.coverageNote: Normal, burning and frozen source states; four separate legs, mouth, four tail joints and tail flower; eight rotation presets. Body uses the game’s normal 1.6× affine scale. Rotation, breathing and tail movement vary continuously, so these are reference-informed editor poses.

catalog.coverageNote: Genuine rocky body, five neck links and distinct jawed head. Front, side, lowered and damaged arrangements use the available directional source frames. Neck curves are editable presets; exact ROM animation timings and every curve are not asserted.
